name: Koumyouji Rui
source:
Apartment resident.

A wife who endures her nervous husband's tyranny patiently. She has been married for eight years and used to be Shizuo's editor.

She retired upon marriage, and even though she is now a housewife, she still calls her husband “Sensei”.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532785]Getchu[/url]]
